name.fr-FR: Abrégé des vies des anciens philosophes, avec un recueil de leurs plus belles maximes
name.en-US: Abridgment of the Lives of the Ancient Philosophers, with a Collection of Their Finest Maxims
name.pt-BR: Resumo das vidas dos antigos filósofos, com uma coletânea de suas mais belas máximas

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Les vies de vingt-trois sages et philosophes grecs, de Thalès à Zénon, avec leurs maximes, écrites pour le duc de Bourgogne d’après Diogène Laërce (publié en 1726). L’attribution à Fénelon a été discutée ; l’édition de 1851 le compte parmi ses ouvrages de littérature.
description.en-US: The lives of twenty-three Greek sages and philosophers, from Thales to Zeno, with their maxims, written for the Duke of Burgundy after Diogenes Laertius (published 1726). Fénelon’s authorship has been questioned; the 1851 edition counts it among his literary works.
description.pt-BR: As vidas de vinte e três sábios e filósofos gregos, de Tales a Zenão, com suas máximas, escritas para o duque de Borgonha a partir de Diogenes Laércio (publicadas em 1726). A autoria de Fénelon foi discutida; a edição de 1851 inclui a obra entre as suas obras literárias.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 7, p. 5–84; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md). Authorship doubtful.
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
